_comment: The review course fixture, described ONCE. fixtures/seed.php reads this to
decide what to create; scripts/check-fixture.mjs reads it to verify what
came out. Two lists would be two sources of truth, and the one that drifts
is always the one nobody runs.
Every module here is verified present in BOTH MOODLE_404_STABLE and
MOODLE_500_STABLE against Moodle's own lib/plugins.json. chat and survey
are deliberately absent: they are standard on 4.4 and GONE from 5.0, which
is the default branch, and would be dropped silently on restore.
shortname is NOT 'REVIEW': phpRestoreCourse only takes the requested
shortname if no other course holds it.
users is 0 deliberately — a backup carrying users creates them on restore,
and a preview account of the same name then fails to create. Measured.
